Edition compass · Case 01 · Anna · Joint version 1.1 · 27 October 2026 · Material

Work and publication architecture

  1. Local computer: TEI with prepared support; edit, check and preview files.
  2. Private Labour Repo: Uni-GitLab with consulting. Conscious comparison with the computer; consultation as own performance.
  3. approval and output: Select suitable version, check technical as well as with regard to rights/metadata, clean up internal notes and export files without private Git history. Create HTML/PDF if required.
  4. Own public publication repository: Still open. Released data, documentation and releases; optional web access requires a suitable output path.
  5. Archive service: defined version passed with metadata; access, long-term responsibility and persistent identifier separately agree.

Current release intent: Internal working version. All expenditures remain planned options; external backup and recovery must be independently checked.

Decision paths and data flows as text

TEI and Markdown are alternative working formats; the processing paths lead back to Git-supported source data. Work host and publication host are separate decisions. After the examination, released data, a possible website and a possible print edition arise. A host change requires additionally the examination of accesses, consulting and tool license.
